messages.author: Alexander Hung Lee
messages.body:
Hi Thomas,
Unfortunately not. It works when imin=0 (dynamics) but not when imin=1 (minimization). I'm running Amber 20. Here's my input
&cntrl
imin = 1,
ntmin = 2,
maxcyc = 1000,
cut = 8.0,
ntwr = -10,
ntpr = 50,
ntr = 0,
&end
I only had 1 restart file at the end.
Alex Lee
Woods Lab
ahl63010.uga.edu
